reader.requirement: At 1985 MOD must return argument-1 - (argument-2 * FUNCTION INTEGER (argument-1 / argument-2)), the floored modulus with the sign of argument-2, for every integer argument form (integer items of any usage including P-scaled integers, integer literals, integer arithmetic expressions) up to the 18-digit maximum.

reader.notes: ModScaled takes the truncating quotient and subtracts one when the remainder is nonzero and the signs differ, which is the floor the INTEGER function gives; the final subtraction is checked. A zero divisor returns 0 through ModZeroDivisor (EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION), which the 1985 text leaves undefined. Same output at --std 2023.
